3.13.d: दीदिवांसमपूर्व्यं वस्वीभिरस्य धीतिभिः | रक्वाणो अग्निमिन्धते होतारं विश्पतिं विशाम ||
3.13.e: The singers kindle him, the Priest, Agni the Lord of tribes of men,  Resplendent and without a peer through his own excellent designs.

3.13.d: उत नो बरह्मन्नविष उक्थेषु देवहूतमः | शं नः शोचामरुद्व्र्धो.अग्ने सहस्रसातमः ||
3.13.e: Help us, thou Brahman, best of all invokers of the Gods in song.  Beam, Friend of Maruts, bliss on us, O Agni, a most liberal God.

3.13.d: नू नो रास्व सहस्रवत तोकवत पुष्टिमद वसु | दयुमदग्ने सुवीर्यं वर्षिष्थमनुपक्षितम ||
3.13.e: Yea, grant us treasure thousandfold with children and with nourishment,  And, Agni, splendid hero strength, exalted, wasting not away.

3.14.d: आ होता मन्द्रो विदथान्यस्थात सत्यो यज्वा कवितमः सवेधाः | विद्युद्रथः सहसस पुत्रो अग्निः शोचिष्केशः पर्थिव्यां पाजो अश्रेत ||
3.14.e: THE pleasant Priest is come into the synod, true, skilled in sacrifice, most wise, Ordainer.  Agni, the Son of Strength, whose car is lightning, whose hair is flame, hath shown on earth his lustre.

3.14.d: अयामि ते नमौक्तिं जुषस्व रतावस्तुभ्यं चेतते सहस्वः | विद्वाना वक्षि विदुषो नि षत्सि मध्य आ बर्हिरूतये यजत्र ||
3.14.e: To thee I offer reverent speech: accept it: to thee who markest it, victorious, faithful!  Bring, thou who knowest, those who know, and seat thee amid the sacred grass, for help, O Holy.

3.14.d: दरवतां त उषसा वाजयन्ती अग्ने वातस्य पथ्याभिरछ | यत सीमञ्जन्ति पूर्व्यं हविर्भिरा वन्धुरेव तस्थतुर्दुरोणे ||
3.14.e: The Two who show their vigour, Night and Morning, by the wind's paths shall haste to thee O Agni.  When men adorn the Ancient with oblations, these seek, as on two chariot-seats, the dwelling.

3.14.d: मित्रश्च तुभ्यं वरुणः सहस्वो.अग्ने विश्वे मरुतः सुम्नमर्चन | यच्छोचिषा सहसस पुत्र तिष्ठा अभि कषितीः परथयन सूर्यो नॄन ||
3.14.e: To thee, strong Agni! Varuṇa and Mitra and all the Maruts sang a song of triumph,  What time unto the people's lands thou camest, spreading them as the Sun of men, with lustre.

3.14.d: वयं ते अद्य ररिमा हि काममुत्तानहस्ता नमसोपसद्य | यजिष्ठेन मनसा यक्षि देवानस्रेधता मन्मना विप्रो अग्ने ||
3.14.e: Approaching with raised hands and adoration, we have this day fulfilled for thee thy longing.  Worship the Gods with most devoted spirit, a Priest with no unfriendly thought, O Agni.

3.14.d: तवद धि पुत्र सहसो वि पूर्वीर्देवस्य यन्त्यूतयो वि वाजाः | तवं देहि सहस्रिणं रयिं नो.अद्रोघेण वचसा सत्यमग्ने ||
3.14.e: For, Son of Strength, from thee come many succours, and powers abundant that a God possesses.  Agni, to us with speech that hath no falsehood grant riches, real, to be told in thousands.

3.14.d: तुभ्यं दक्ष कविक्रतो यानीमा देव मर्तासो अध्वरे अकर्म | तवं विश्वस्य सुरथस्य बोधि सर्वं तदग्ने अम्र्त सवदेह ||
3.14.e: Whatever, God, in sacrifice we mortals have wrought is all for thee, strong, wise of purpose!  Be thou the Friend of each good chariot's master. All this enjoy thou here, immortal Agni.

3.15.d: वि पाजसा पर्थुना शोशुचानो बाधस्व दविषो रक्षसो अमीवाः | सुशर्मणो बर्हतः शर्मणि सयामग्नेरहं सुहवस्य परणीतौ ||
3.15.e: RESPLENDENT with thy wide-extending lustre, dispel the terrors of the fiends who hate us  May lofty Agni be my guide and shelter, the easily-invoked, the good Protector.

3.15.d: तवं नो अस्या उषसो वयुष्टौ तवं सूर उदिते बोधि गोपाः | जन्मेव नित्यं तनयं जुषस्व सतोमं मे अग्ने तन्वा सुजात ||
3.15.e: Be thou To us, while now the morn is breaking, be thou a guardian when the Sun hath mounted..  Accept, as men accept a true-born infant, my laud, O Agni nobly born in body.

3.15.d: तवं नर्चक्षा वर्षभानु पूर्वीः कर्ष्णास्वग्ने अरुषो विभाहि | वसो नेषि च पर्षि चात्यंहः कर्धी नो राय उशिजो यविष्ठ ||
3.15.e: Bull, who beholdest men, through many mornings, among the dark ones shine forth red, O Agni.  Lead us, good Lord, and bear us over trouble: Help us who long, Most Youthful God, to riches.

3.15.d: अषाळ्हो अग्ने वर्षभो दिदीहि पुरो विश्वाः सौभगा संजिगीवान | यज्ञस्य नेता परथमस्य पायोर्जातवेदो बर्हतः सुप्रणीते ||
3.15.e: Shine forth, a Bull invincible, O Agni, winning by conquest all the forts and treasures,  Thou Jātavedas who art skilled in guiding, the chief high saving sacrifice's Leader.

3.15.d: अछिद्रा शर्म जरितः पुरूणि देवानछा दीद्यानः सुमेधाः | रथो न सस्निरभि वक्षि वाजमगने तवं रोदसीनः सुमेके ||
3.15.e: Lighting Gods hither, Agni, wisest Singer, bring thou to us many and flawless shelters.  Bring vigour, like a car that gathers booty: bring us, O Agni, beauteous Earth and Heaven.

3.15.d: पर पीपय वर्षभ जिन्व वाजानग्ने तवं रोदसी नः सुदोघे | देवेभिर्देव सुरुचा रुचानो मा नो मर्तस्य दुर्मतिः परि षठात ||
3.15.e: Swell, O thou Bull and give those powers an impulse, e’en Earth and Heaven who yield their milk in plenty,  Shining, O God, with Gods in clear effulgence. Let not a mortal's evil will obstruct us.
Agni, as holy food to thine invoker, give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels.  To us be born a son and spreading offspring. Agni, be this thy gracious will to us-ward.

3.16.d: अयमग्निः सुवीर्यस्येशे महः सौभगस्य | राय ईशे सवपत्यस्य गोमत ईशे वर्त्रहथानाम ||
3.16.e: THIS Agni is the Lord of great felicity and hero Strength;  Lord of wealth in herds of kine; Lord of the battles with the foe.

3.16.d: इमं नरो मरुतः सश्चता वर्धं यस्मिन रायः शेव्र्धासः | अभि ये सन्ति पर्तनासु दूढ्यो विश्वाहा शत्रुमादभुः ||
3.16.e: Wait, Maruts, Heroes, upon him the Prosperer in whom is bliss-increasing wealth;  Who in fights ever conquer evil-hearted men, who overcome the enemy.

3.16.d: स तवं नो रायः शिशीहि मीढ्वो अग्ने सुविर्यस्य | तुविद्युम्न वर्षिष्ठस्य परजावतो.अनमीवस्य शुष्मिणः ||
3.16.e: As such, O Agni, deal us wealth and hero might, O Bounteous One!  Most lofty, very glorious, rich in progeny, free from disease and full of power.

3.16.d: चक्रिर्यो विश्वा भुवनाभि सासहिश्चक्रिर्देवेष्वा दुवः | आ देवेषु यतत आ सुवीर्य आ शंस उत नर्णाम ||
3.16.e: He who made all that lives, who passes all in might, who orders service to the Gods,  He works among the Gods, he works in hero strength, yea, also in the praise of men.

3.16.d: मा नो अग्ने.अमतये मावीरतायै रीरधः | मागोतायै सहसस पुत्र मा निदे.अप दवेषांस्या कर्धि ||
3.16.e: Give us not up to indigence, Agni, nor want of hero sons,  Nor, Son of Strength, to lack of cattle, nor to blame. Drive. thou our enemies away.

3.16.d: शग्धि वाजस्य सुभग परजावतो.अग्ने बर्हतो अध्वरे | संराया भूयसा सर्ज मयोभुना तुविद्युम्न यशस्वता ||
3.16.e: Help us to strength, blest Agni! rich in progeny, abundant, in our sacrifice.  Flood us with riches yet more plenteous, bringing weal, with high renown, most Glorious One!
